messages.text: Darkness Falls strikes Dewhurst gold for O'Brien

metadata.summary: Darkness Falls took over at the top of the 2000 Guineas market after edging a heavyweight clash against previously unbeaten Desert Castle in a thrilling Darley Dewhurst Stakes at Newmarket.
metadata.content: Dewhurst Stakes: Darkness Falls ignites triple crown dreams with Newmarket triumph | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Dewhurst Stakes: Darkness Falls ignites triple crown dreams with Newmarket triumph Darkness Falls, who was highlighted as a potential future triple crown horse by Aidan O'Brien, dug deep to deny Desert Castle in the Group 1 Darley Dewhurst Stakes at Newmarket Saturday 10 October 2026 15:41, UK Image: Darkness Falls won the Dewhurst under Ryan Moore Darkness Falls took over at the top of the 2000 Guineas market after edging a heavyweight clash against previously unbeaten Desert Castle in a thrilling Darley Dewhurst Stakes at Newmarket. Dropping back in trip to seven furlongs from a mile and one after winning the Golden Fleece Stakes at Leopardstown last time out, the Aidan O'Brien-trained Camelot colt - who was already favourite for the Derby - showed he has both pace and stamina. After taking up the running under Ryan Moore approaching the dip, the Ballydoyle runner was not for passing, landing the Group One contest by a neck at odds of 6-4 from 10-11 favourite Desert Castle and William Buick. Rock Montreal battles to Autumn Stakes victory Rock Montreal produced a battling display to land the Group Three Emirates Autumn Stakes at Newmarket and deliver Godolphin with yet another potential Classic prospect for next spring. messages.text: 'McLaren will be furious!' - Was Norris to blame for Piastri collision?

metadata.summary: The overtake Lando Norris attempted on Oscar Piastri that resulted in the McLaren team-mates crashing on the final lap of the Singapore Grand Prix Sprint was "not smart", according to Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle.
metadata.content: Singapore GP: McLaren 'will be furious' at Lando Norris-Oscar Piastri crash during Sprint, says Martin Brundle | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Singapore GP: McLaren 'will be furious' at Lando Norris-Oscar Piastri crash during Sprint, says Martin Brundle Lando Norris and his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri crashed on the final lap of the Singapore Grand Prix Sprint; the incident cost McLaren eight championship points; watch Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix at 1pm (build-up from 11.30am) live on Sky Sports F1 Saturday 10 October 2026 12:39, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri make contact during the last lap of the Sprint race at the Singapore Grand Prix The overtake Lando Norris attempted on Oscar Piastri that resulted in the McLaren team-mates crashing on the final lap of the Singapore Grand Prix Sprint was "not smart", according to Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle. Norris had narrowly trailed Piastri in a battle for fourth for most of the 20-lap race at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, where overtaking is extremely difficult. Norris tried to go up the inside of Turn 5 on the final circuit, which led to a crash as Piastri turned in, with the Australian spun around as his rear-right tyre was struck by his team-mate's front-left. messages.text: 'We win major trophies here': Palmer signs new Chelsea contract

metadata.summary: Cole Palmer has signed a contract extension with Chelsea.
metadata.content: Cole Palmer contract: Chelsea forward signs extension at Stamford Bridge until 2034 | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cole Palmer contract: Chelsea forward signs extension at Stamford Bridge until 2034 Palmer agrees one-year extension; the deal follows contracts handed to Joao Pedro, Pedro Neto, Reece James and Moises Caicedo in the past year Saturday 10 October 2026 11:38, UK Image: Palmer has won two trophies with Chelsea since arriving from Man City in 2023 Cole Palmer has signed a contract extension with Chelsea. The star forward has agreed a one-year extension on his previous deal with improved terms, committing him to the club until 2034. "Chelsea means a lot to me and I think the club is going in the right direction, so I'm delighted to sign and I'm obviously very happy,' Palmer said. Transfer Centre LIVE! | Chelsea news & transfers 🔵 Chelsea fixtures & scores | FREE Chelsea highlights ▶️ "Speaking to the owners, to the sporting directors and obviously the manager, they gave me a lot of confidence so it was only right to sign. "Speaking to players as well, everyone has the same ambitions. I feel like we win major trophies here consistently and I want to be a part of that and play a big role in it too." He has won the Conference League and Club World Cup with the Blues since joining from Man City in 2023.
